statement.zh: Wheeler《Ancient India》3（1947）报告 1946 年哈拉帕城防与 R37 墓地发掘（历史 P；绝对年代框架须用现代测年校正）。
statement.en: Wheeler’s Ancient India 3 (1947) reports 1946 excavations of Harappa’s defences and Cemetery R37 (historical P; absolute chronology needs modern radiocarbon frameworks).
